resources.name: Elk FP-LAPW code

access.notes: Full-potential linearized augmented plane-wave code; open-source under GPL. Used for all DFT total-energy, band-structure, and optical matrix-element calculations.

resources.notes: Equivalent full-potential code with Engel-Vosko GGA or similar may be substituted.
